full_prompt_en: The image is a square, finely rendered painterly illustration of four uniformed men standing shoulder to shoulder beneath flying birds at dusk. A blue-gray sky fills the upper half, darkening into soft cloud at the sides and warming to a narrow rose-orange strip along the low horizon. Below it lies a flat, muted brown landscape with little distinct detail. The men occupy almost the entire width of the lower center, their upper bodies overlapping closely but faces turned in different directions. At the far left, an older gray-haired man in an olive-brown coat looks left in profile, with a prominent pale mustache and a tall peaked cap. Just right of him, a man in a dark navy uniform faces slightly left of the viewer; he has a black mustache, a brimmed dark cap, and tan leather straps running over his shoulders to a pouch at his chest. Behind and to his right, a younger clean-shaven man in another dark uniform turns right, his pale side face set below a dark peaked cap. On the far right, a man in a brick-red uniform and striped cap looks right in profile, with a dark mustache and short pointed beard. Brass or gold buttons, collar tabs, belts, and shoulder details punctuate the dark fabrics without overwhelming their broad silhouettes. Above them, three pale birds fly across the upper sky at different heights, their wings spread and their warm gray shadows visible against the blue. The nearest large bird passes over the left group, while the other two rise toward the upper center and right. Soft dusk light comes from the low horizon behind the men, giving the edges of faces and birds a muted warmth while the uniforms remain mostly shaded. Fine modeling defines the faces and leather; the sky and ground are smoother and less detailed. The frontal, waist-up grouping makes the repeated caps, alternating profiles, and pale flying shapes the main rhythm. The overall composition sets dark disciplined figures against an open blue-gray dusk, with red cloth and ivory wings carrying the strongest color accents.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、刻画精细的绘画性插画，四名身着制服的男子在暮色中并肩站立，头顶有鸟飞过。蓝灰天空占据上半部，两侧渐成柔软暗云，低地平线上有一道狭窄玫瑰橙色光带。其下是平坦、低饱和的棕色土地，几乎没有明确细节。男子们几乎占满下方中央整个宽度，上半身紧密交叠，面孔却朝不同方向。最左边一位灰发年长男子穿橄榄棕外套，带明显浅色胡须，戴高尖帽，朝左侧身望去。他右边一位穿深海军蓝制服的男子略朝观者左侧，蓄黑色胡须，戴有檐深帽，褐色皮带从肩上斜过，连到胸前小袋。他身后偏右的一位更年轻、无胡须男子穿另一套深色制服，朝右转，浅色侧脸露在深色尖帽下。最右边的男子穿砖红色制服和条纹帽，朝右侧身，留深色小胡子与短尖下巴须。黄铜或金色纽扣、领章、皮带与肩饰点亮深衣料，却没有压过其宽大剪影。三只浅色鸟在上方天空不同高度飞行，翅膀展开，暖灰色背阴面在蓝色前可见。最近的大鸟飞过左侧人群，其余两只升向中央上方与右边。柔和暮光从男子身后的低地平线进入，让面部和鸟的边缘带低调暖色，制服大部分仍在阴影里。细致塑形确定面孔与皮革；天空和地面更平顺，细节更少。正面、腰部以上的群像让重复帽形、交替侧脸和浅色飞形构成主要节奏。整体构图把深色、端正的人形置于开阔蓝灰暮色前，红衣与象牙色翅膀承载最强色彩强调。
style_prompt_en: Finely rendered painterly illustration models close foreground forms with controlled tonal transitions and lets the surrounding atmosphere remain broader and quieter. Deep navy, olive-brown, and blue-gray take most of the area, while brick red, pale ivory, and a narrow warm horizon provide deliberate accents. Repeated upright silhouettes overlap tightly in the lower region, balanced by a few light, widely spaced shapes above. Edges are clear around focal contours and softer where dark masses meet the dusky ground. Low warm backlight lifts selected rims without strong glare, leaving substantial cool shade within the grouped forms. Small metallic and leather-like details are drawn precisely against simpler fabric and sky. The overall effect is solemn, orderly, and atmospheric, with color restraint and alternating directions creating visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 刻画精细的绘画性插画以受控明暗转折塑造近处形体，让周围空气更宽阔安静。深海军蓝、橄榄棕和蓝灰占据多数面积，砖红、浅象牙色和一条窄暖色水平带提供有意的强调。重复竖向剪影在下部紧密交叠，上方少量浅色形状则宽松分布与之平衡。焦点轮廓清楚，深色大块接近暮色底面处较柔。低位暖背光提亮选定边缘而没有强眩光，组合形体内部保有大量冷阴影。细小金属与皮革感细节在较简单的布面和天空前被准确描出。整体效果肃静、有序且富于空气感，克制配色与方向交替形成视觉节奏。
theme_en: Four uniformed men standing shoulder to shoulder beneath birds at dusk
theme_zh: 四名身着制服的男子在暮色中并肩而立，头顶有飞鸟
name: Eduard Gaertner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
